independent_recomputation.governing_standard: ASC 360 — changes in accounting estimates applied prospectively

root_cause: Arithmetic error in authoring template. The formula in the explanation was correct (($159,000 - $18,000) / 7) but the stated result ($21,750) was wrong. $21,750 x 7 = $152,250, implying a residual of $6,750 instead of $18,000 — consistent with a mis-keyed subtraction or template bug.

A_$22,200.concept: Ignores accumulated depreciation, uses original cost over new total life

B_$27,000.concept: Original annual depreciation, ignores revision entirely

C_$19,286.concept: Uses original residual instead of revised residual
